item.title: Celebrating 50 Years of Hōkūle’a
item.description: Navigating by the Stars Hawai‘i’s legendary voyaging canoe first launched on March 8, 1975. Since then, it has completed 14 major voyages including Tahiti, Aotearoa, Rapa Nui, Japan, Canada, and the continental United States.
